_comment: Printed stat values that the generated cards.json gets wrong. Every value below was read off the printed card scan in assets/cards/en/, not inferred. The printed card always wins over the community database.
_scope: Only stats confirmed wrong against a scan are listed. No systematic sweep of every card has been done, so absence from this file does not mean a stat is correct.
_shape: cards maps a card id to the stat fields to overwrite.

_notes.078: DTG-30M "Hyena" MG Type. Database says offensive; the printed stance strip reads DEF. All three Hyenas (078, 079, 080) print DEF, and the database only has 080 right.
_notes.079: DTG-30S "Hyena" Missile Type. Same as 078: database offensive, card prints DEF.
_notes.159: AMDS210 "Delphinium" Automatic Defense System. Database says mobility; the printed strip reads OFF · ✗ in red. Its Move box is printed blank, so the recorded Move 0 is correct and is not patched.
_notes.161: ADK15/MAS "Porcupine" Microwave Type. The card database records Move 0, but the scan prints the same ↑5 Move box in the bottom-right as its two siblings ADK15D (160) and ADK15P (543), both of which the database has at 5.
_notes.074: GM-35 Anti-Armor Mine. Recorded as electronic -1; the card prints "--" in the Electronic box, meaning no value. Every other card printing "--" (154, 155, 267, 268, PDAM-003/004/005) is recorded as 0, so -1 is a misparse of the dash. It matters because electronicValue() sums this field, so -1 actively subtracts 1, and the reference page renders it as "E-1".
_notes.158: DBP "Turtle Shell" Barricade. Same "--" misparse as 074.
_notes.ZHAM-002: M60 "Boomerang" Missile. The card prints only two stat boxes, an orange Electronic 1 and a grey Armor 3, with no blue Dodge box at all; the database records armor 0 and dodge 6. Box colours were confirmed by sampling pixels, not by eye: the orange box spans x540-594 and the grey x618-666, and no blue pixels appear anywhere in the stat row. On this same GOF template ZHAM-003 prints orange/blue/grey for electronic/dodge/armor and ZHAM-004 prints blue/grey for dodge/armor, so a lone grey box after the orange one is Armor. Confirmed by a second reader against the card: 1 electronic, 3 grey, no Dodge icon present.
